_comment: LIMIT-TEST CONTENT (2026-08-18): the kitchen-sink AURA - one effect of every type the aura tick path dispatches (sys.applyAuraEffect: damage/dot/slow/heal/hot/shield/resist/speed) plus the rendering-only light_aura, with every damage rider authored at once (crit, execute, berserker, lifesteal, structures, variance, hitStyle). Cheat-only, godlike on purpose: SKILL OmniAura; NO unlock source, and none is ever planned - this skill exists to stress the multi-effect machinery and to teach authoring, not to be played. Deliberate choices: ONE shared beat (tickInterval 40 on all eight, the R3/F5 rule) so every effect prices against the same health in the same tick; damage first (the near-floor ordering rule: the LAST effect is the one an almost-dead caster skips); gateKey absent because it is mutually exclusive with damageTags on one effect - a gated hit declares no damage type, so one effect can never author both; resist wildcard '*' must be the ONLY resistTags entry (factor 0.5 here = halve everything, not invulnerability); speed_aura is structurally ally-only (no targetsSelf key exists) and its factor must be > 1. Small real costs on four effects exercise sequential per-tick charging and the 1 HP never-kill clamp. All values [PLACEHOLDER] and NEARLY irrelevant - this is a test rig, not balance; the one bound that IS load-bearing (found 2026-08-18, portal C1's cp-defs surfaced it): the simharness ceiling guardrail has no cheat-only concept, so the damage numbers must keep max-level EV/tick below the weakest §A ceiling ref, and the damaging effects must agree on radius (the shared sensor rule). Godlike in BREADTH, deliberately not in throughput.
name: OmniAura
